in_marathi.name: Dinabandhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Day giver, friend of the day
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dinabandhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dinabandhu is a name derived from Sanskrit roots 'dina' meaning 'day' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend'. This name symbolizes one who is a giver of days, a friend to all on the daily basis.
